name: surface-app
doc: Background of the whole application window; the bottom layer every other surface sits on. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-panel1
doc: Background of panels laid directly on `surfaces/app` (sidebars, cards, toolbars); first layer of the surface stack. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-panel1-hover
doc: Hover background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel1`. Panels rarely have a hover state; use only when a panel-colored element is interactive. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-panel1-selected
doc: Selected background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel1`. Panels rarely have a selected state; use only when a panel-colored element can be selected. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-panel2
doc: Background of panels nested inside `surfaces/panel1` (or placed directly on `surfaces/app`); second layer of the surface stack. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-panel2-hover
doc: Hover background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel2`. Panels rarely have a hover state; use only when a panel-colored element is interactive. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-panel2-selected
doc: Selected background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel2`. Panels rarely have a selected state; use only when a panel-colored element can be selected. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-overlay
doc: Background of elements floating above the whole app: dialogs, popovers, menus, tooltips, notifications. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-text
doc: Main text color on every surface of the set. Meets WCAG AAA against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Monochrome icons use it too (or `textMuted` when they should be muted). Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-text-muted
doc: Secondary, muted text color on every surface of the set. Meets WCAG AAA where possible and at least WCAG AA. Monochrome icons use it when they should recede. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-text-subtle
doc: Faintest text color over `bg`, `bgHover` and `bgSelected`: placeholders, hints and captions. Roughly 3 to 4:1 contrast, below WCAG AA in some roles, so never use it for essential text. Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

name: surface-alternate-row-bg
doc: Background of every second row in tables, lists, trees and property grids. Translucent, so it works on any surface (panel1, panel2, overlay); the row itself has no background. Hover and selected rows use the neutral element backgrounds.

name: surface-link
doc: Text color of inline links and link-style buttons at rest.

name: surface-link-hover
doc: Text color of links while hovered.

name: surface-border
doc: Main border color of components, on any surface or fill: inputs, outlined buttons, toggles, checkboxes and radios. Translucent black (light) / white (dark), so it composites onto whichever background it sits on, colored fills included.

name: surface-border-muted
doc: Muted border color for surfaces and dividers: panels, overlays, cards, tables, separators, the window edge and outlines that should recede. Translucent black (light) / white (dark), so it composites onto whichever background it sits on.

name: surface-text-danger
doc: Danger text and icons drawn directly on a surface: destructive menu items, field error messages, negative values. At least WCAG AA (5.9:1 Light, 8:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on a danger fill uses `roles/danger/text`. The same in every accent.

name: surface-text-success
doc: Success text and icons drawn directly on a surface: positive values, success messages, valid-field hints. At least WCAG AA (4.6:1 Light, 10:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on a success fill uses `roles/success/text`. The same in every accent.

name: surface-scrim
doc: Backdrop behind modal overlays (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet): a translucent black layer between the app and the overlay that dims the content below. The same in every accent.

name: surface-text-info
doc: Informational text and icons drawn directly on a surface: outlined info tags, notes, hints that carry information. At least WCAG AA (6.2:1 Light, 8.4:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on an info fill uses `roles/alerts/info/text`. The same in every accent.

name: surface-text-warning
doc: Warning text and icons drawn directly on a surface: outlined warning tags, cautions, values near a limit. At least WCAG AA (4.6:1 Light, 10.5:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on a warning fill uses `roles/alerts/warning/text`. The same in every accent.

name: surface-on-media
doc: Text and icons drawn over pictures and video, such as the Video control bar on `surfaces/scrim`: white in both color modes, because the media below stays the same in Light and Dark. The same in every accent.

name: intent-neutral-bg
doc: Resting background of the element (button, tab, chip, alert, and similar). Neutral role: default components without semantic meaning (secondary buttons, tabs, inputs, list items). Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

name: intent-neutral-bg-strong
doc: Strongest neutral background, laid over the element's own surface: tracks (switch, slider, group box), indicators (carousel, stepper), skeletons and placeholders, avatars and tags. Next step after bgSelected.

name: intent-neutral-bg-translucent
doc: Translucent tint of the role color for soft elements that let the surface behind show through: inactive badges, soft tags and chips, the hover of transparent elements. Lighter than `bg`. Neutral role: default components without semantic meaning (secondary buttons, tabs, inputs, list items). Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

name: intent-neutral-bg-hover
doc: Background of the element while the pointer hovers over it. Neutral role: default components without semantic meaning (secondary buttons, tabs, inputs, list items). Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

name: intent-neutral-bg-selected
doc: Background of the element when selected or toggled on. Neutral role: default components without semantic meaning (secondary buttons, tabs, inputs, list items). Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

name: intent-neutral-bg-selected-hover

name: intent-neutral-text
doc: Main text color over `bg`, `bgHover` and `bgSelected`. At least WCAG AA (4.5:1) against them, AAA where the fill allows. Neutral role: default components without semantic meaning (secondary buttons, tabs, inputs, list items). Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

name: interaction-disabled-bg
doc: Background of a disabled component, laid over the element's own surface: a muted gray veil that darkens in light mode and lightens in dark mode. Also used when the disabled component is selected or toggled on.

name: interaction-disabled-fg
doc: Text and icon color of a disabled component, laid over the element's own surface: readable but clearly inactive, darkening in light mode and lightening in dark mode. Also used when the disabled component is selected or toggled on.

name: interaction-disabled-border
doc: Border of a disabled component, laid over the element's own surface: a gray edge one step stronger than `disabledBg`, darkening in light mode and lightening in dark mode. Also used when the disabled component is selected or toggled on.

name: interaction-focus-ring
doc: Focus ring drawn around the keyboard-focused component (buttons, inputs, checkboxes, list items). Follows the theme accent.

name: interaction-focus-ring-danger
doc: Focus ring drawn around a keyboard-focused danger component (danger buttons, invalid fields). The same in every accent.

name: interaction-focus-ring-success
doc: Focus ring drawn around a keyboard-focused success component (success buttons, valid fields). The same in every accent.

name: interaction-drag-border
doc: Border or outline of an element while it is being dragged (data table columns, dock panels, property grid rows).

name: interaction-drop-target
doc: Highlight fill of a valid drop target while something is dragged over it (dock zones, lists). Uses the translucent tint of the current accent.

name: interaction-caret
doc: Blinking text cursor in editable fields (inputs, number fields, OTP fields, text areas, code editor).

name: interaction-text-selection-fg
doc: Text color of selected text inside editable fields; sits on `textSelectionBg`.

name: interaction-text-selection-bg
doc: Highlight behind selected text inside editable fields. Follows the theme accent.

name: spacing-gap1
doc: Layout gap step 1 of 8, between tightly related components. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-gap2
doc: Layout gap step 2 of 8, between related components. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-gap3
doc: Layout gap step 3 of 8, between form rows. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-gap4
doc: Layout gap step 4 of 8, between form rows and small groups. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-gap5
doc: Layout gap step 5 of 8, between groups. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-gap6
doc: Layout gap step 6 of 8, between sections. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-gap7
doc: Layout gap step 7 of 8, between large sections. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-gap8
doc: Layout gap step 8 of 8, between page regions. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

name: spacing-inset1
doc: Inset scale, step 1: padding inside a container, the same on every side. Pairs with spacing/gap1-8 for the space between items.

name: spacing-inset2
doc: Inset scale, step 2: padding inside a container, the same on every side. Pairs with spacing/gap1-8 for the space between items.

name: spacing-inset3
doc: Inset scale, step 3: padding inside a container, the same on every side. Pairs with spacing/gap1-8 for the space between items.

name: spacing-inset4
